conditions.eligibility: Unprotected music control showed ads in four five-second samples. Fresh default Brave showed ads in three samples. These are samples, not distinct ad counts.
conditions.supported_results: Protected normal/private watch, SPA, playlist/autoplay, Shorts looping and three feed transitions, cross-site permitted embed, nine-minute playback and foreground media controls passed.
limits: The nine-minute film did not establish observed mid-roll ad eligibility.
Shorts control had no observed ads, so Shorts-specific ad eligibility is unknown.
The music embed was unavailable with protection both on and off; the permitted Blender embed passed.
The 20-second diagnostic buffered initially and missed its playback criterion; the 90-second foreground controls rerun passed.
Earlier automation-controlled probes stalled; ordinary windowed probes did not reproduce that stall. The exact underlying server/browser cause is not established.
Native fullscreen/PiP API outcomes and foreground behavior were checked; accessibility and OS window interaction remain separate manual acceptance.
